contract: Only a native claim from the pre-registered DirectPlay pool may begin as a pristine discovery reservation.
The initial native GNSInfoPacket is transport discovery and does not consume a game identity.
Any incoming payload on the authenticated native connection commits the identity before size validation, local delivery or peer forwarding. Malformed payloads conservatively consume it too.
Any ordinary outbound Sith packet commits its native destination before transmission, including the all-clients helper. Legitimate initial traffic is not suppressed to preserve a reservation.

A terminal pristine reservation returns to its unused pool slot without a retirement notification or queued ProcessPlayerLost event. Its old GNS handle is removed; delayed input on that handle cannot affect a later reservation.

Used or uncertain connections retain permanent retirement and fresh DirectPlay replacement. Lack of WELCOME, an unjoined roster slot, or a Connecting callback state does not establish that a connection was unused.
Browser/retail ADD and no-pool native connections remain immediately committed. Session history and the limit of 65,536 identities remain; map transitions do not clear history.

independent_actual_method_regression.method: Extracts production Client_t, Receive, Send, SendBytesToAllClients and RetireNativeConnection definitions verbatim. Compiles them with the actual TransportIdentities header against bounded inert transport/admin sinks; no network or game assets.
coverage: Pristine departure releases its reservation without a game-loss event or retirement notification.
Incoming host delivery commits the actual authenticated sender before returning the payload.
Peer forwarding commits both the incoming source and outgoing destination before reaching the send sink.
Ordinary outbound traffic commits its destination before send and leaves unrelated reservations pristine.
Malformed inbound payload commits before validation rejection.
A removed old GNS handle cannot commit or retire a later connection using the same unused reservation.
The all-clients send helper commits every actual recipient and preserves an explicitly excluded connection.
